subject: [cam] opus-cam started: Camera/AVFoundation integration of the hw encoder/decoder
body: Host only. Plan: (1) P04 review + changes in gpu/hwcodec/vt/n2hwenc_{vt,client}.c (marked opus-cam): async worker (2 frames in flight, emit deferred to VT calling thread), fast-fail StartSession (<2 s, retry on BUSY/RESTART), no ENC_SET before the first picture (ENC_SET never ran on the phone: folded into the first-frame reopen; later ENC_SET failure non-fatal), stride repack (the client does one RWVC_DMA_RW per row when the CVPixelBuffer pitch != align16(width)), first-picture summary line; (2) stage-vcodec.sh --prod + guest-vcodec.sh prod mode (vcodecd only, no probes, claim-hw+hwdec ON, KeepAlive, restart-on-switch); (3) gpu/hwcodec/CAMERA_INTEGRATION.md with the Camera test plan. hw-p04 / hw-dec06 owners: I am editing vt/n2hwenc_vt.c + n2hwenc_client.c + vt/test; tell me if you have edits in flight. opus-enc4k: please do not change the encoder OPEN/ENC_FRAME wire behaviour without a note; I rely on OPEN carrying bitrate/fps/gop/profile and level 0 = auto.
